blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) leadership has challenged its personnel to achieve a 100-percent efficiency rate in handling Unified 911 calls, up from 96.15 percent recorded in the first eight months of 2026. “An efficiency rate of 96.15 percent is a strong performance, but for a service as critical as Unified 911, every second matters and every call could mean a life,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez, Jr. in a statement on Sunday. “We must not be satisfied with what we have achieved.
